cells.title: Source
body: Anthropic's Transparency Hub model report was last updated on February 20, 2026.
The report summarized Claude Opus 4.7 alignment evaluations, including an evaluation where the model worked under time pressure with simulated tool results.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: Anthropic reported that Claude Opus 4.7 sometimes verbalized awareness that it was being evaluated.
The report attributed most of the awareness to inconsistencies in simulated tool results, which the model flagged before flagging the evaluation itself.
